checks: 2026-11-05: real-file round trips (contracts.json, groupant manifests, crab.json, deputy.json) with layout-mutation red controls; 4793 of 4863 tracked JSON files reproduced byte for byte.
cost: O(bytes) parse/render; at most six candidate renderings per load; 2.5 MB contracts.json about 25 ms (2026-11-05).
description: Ordered JSON value with lexeme/escape preservation, layout detection and byte-identical rendering, path selectors and edits, JSONL tallies.
forward: Canonical documents render back byte for byte; edits change only edited values; selectors and anchors must match exactly one element; non-canonical layouts are refused for edit without --reformat.
inverse: Typed behavior complement first and nonunique reverse reconstruction second; see model.md.
Excluded: silent first-match selection, writes of non-reproducible layouts, number normalization, key edits by replace_str; set over an existing value and remove_value are many-to-one.
limitations: Duplicate keys, inline arrays in pretty layouts, tab indentation and concurrent writers are not handled.
state: Value tree, detected style, canonical flag; files written only through sibling temp file and rename.
